market.asset_selection_rule: the three assets of the frozen ARC universe are all used: BTCUSDT as the leader (never traded) and ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT as the traded followers. No follower may be removed using outcome information after execution begins.
market.aru_three_asset_interpretation: the ARU queue entry says "3 assets" for the SYNCHRONIZED price universe (leader + followers); the traded set is the two followers, because the mechanism claims follower CONTINUATION after a leader shock. This interpretation is frozen here, before any economics.

data_authority.reuse: REUSABLE (byte-identical) - the certified ARC-03 5m authority is reused; ARC-02 downloads nothing
data_authority.data_root_env: ARC02_DATA_ROOT (absolute; wrong root and empty root both fail closed)

funding_authority.classification: RUNTIME_AUTHORITATIVE (reuse, byte-verified against the certified ARC-01 funding digests)
funding_authority.role: CASHFLOW LEG ONLY - never a signal input
funding_authority.timestamp_semantics: funding_time_ms == availability_time_ms == settlement_time_ms; funding is knowable exactly at settlement
funding_authority.interval_field: funding_interval_hours (read per row; a fixed 8h cadence is never assumed)

common_window.derivation: INTERSECTION of the admitted ARC-02 projection partitions of all three assets on 5m bar-OPEN times (latest first open, earliest last open)
common_window.bound_semantics: CLOSED interval on 5m bar-OPEN times: bar_open_time_ms in [start_ms, end_ms]
common_window.window_span_days_semantics: (end_ms - start_ms + 300000) / 86400000; a FROZEN CONSTANT used by G5 annualization, not a realized trade span
common_window.window_selection_basis: provider availability + common asset coverage + PIT validity + resource limits ONLY. The 2024-only draft window was rejected precisely because a broader official authority was reusable without contamination; no economic consideration participated.

engineering_closure_required.signal_at_the_final_bars: a decision whose entry bar (t+300000) or exit bar (t+600000) would exceed end_ms is NOT emitted (NO_SIGNAL / INSUFFICIENT_FORWARD_PRICE_DATA). The last two 5m slots therefore produce no trades; a deliberate frozen clock-censoring guard, not a data defect.

decision_cadence.cadence: ONE decision per COMPLETED 5m slot in which BOTH the leader bar and the follower bar exist
decision_cadence.decision_time_definition: decision_time_ms = max(leader.bar_close_time_ms, follower.bar_close_time_ms) at the aligned slot
decision_cadence.alignment_requirement: the leader bar and the follower bar must share the SAME bar_open_time_ms; a missing leader bar at the slot is NO_SIGNAL / BAR_ALIGNMENT_FAILURE and a missing follower bar is NO_SIGNAL / FOLLOWER_BAR_MISSING
decision_cadence.informational_justification: every signal component (leader log return, leader trailing scale, follower log return) is a property of exactly one completed 5m bar per asset, so the slot's close is the first instant at which the complete signal is knowable. A coarser grid would skip signal slots without new information; a finer grid is impossible because the provider cadence is 5m.
decision_cadence.eligible_leader_window: only COMPLETED leader bars: bar_close_time_ms <= decision_time_ms; the forming bar is invisible
decision_cadence.eligible_reference_window: the 288 strictly trailing leader returns at slots t - j*300000 for j = 1..288, each formed from bars that closed before the decision
decision_cadence.runtime_defaults: NONE: no hidden default cadence, no calendar fallback

btc_shock.name: ROBUST_TRAILING_SHOCK
btc_shock.return_requires: the leader bars at t and t-BAR_MS must both be present and on the 5m grid; otherwise LEADER_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE (fail closed)
btc_shock.minimum_observations_detail: ALL 288 trailing leader returns must be formable. A single missing reference fails the decision closed with LEADER_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE; no partial-window admission, no synthesis, no shrinkage toward a shorter window.
btc_shock.location_estimator: NONE (zero by construction): the scale is NOT centred. Removing an estimated mean would add a second estimated parameter for no mechanism reason, since the mean 5m log return is treated as zero a priori.

scale_estimator.name: MEDIAN_ABSOLUTE_TRAILING_RETURN
scale_estimator.median_definition: ascending order statistics; for the EVEN count 288 the median is the arithmetic mean of the two central values ((x[143] + x[144]) / 2, 0-indexed)

btc_shock.inequality: STRICT_GREATER_THAN (|z(t)| > 3.0; a statistic of exactly 3.0 is NOT a shock)
btc_shock.rationale: a robust median-absolute scale is used instead of a standard deviation because 5m crypto returns are heavy-tailed and a single outlier in the lookback would inflate a variance-based scale and suppress the very shocks the mechanism is about. 288 bars is exactly one day of 5m slots: the shortest lookback that spans a full intraday cycle at this cadence. 3.0 is the conventional extreme-value cutoff for a robust standardised deviation, fixed from convention, NOT from returns.
btc_shock.zero_scale_behavior: if s(t) == 0.0 the decision fails closed with NO_SIGNAL / LEADER_SCALE_ZERO
btc_shock.zero_return_behavior: r_btc(t) == 0.0 can never satisfy |z| > 3 when s(t) > 0, so a flat leader bar is NO_SIGNAL / NO_BTC_SHOCK
btc_shock.non_finite_behavior: a non-finite value fails the decision closed; the data authority already rejects non-finite rows (defence in depth)

follower_underreaction.name: SAME_SIGN_PROPORTIONAL_UNDERREACTION
follower_underreaction.return_definition: r_f(t) = ln( close_f(t) / close_f(t - BAR_MS) ) for the follower f in {ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT}
follower_underreaction.you_cannot_apply_to_the_leader: the follower condition is evaluated per follower; the leader is never a follower
follower_underreaction.same_sign_semantics: SAME_SIGN(t) <=> (r_btc(t) > 0 AND r_f(t) > 0) OR (r_btc(t) < 0 AND r_f(t) < 0)
follower_underreaction.rationale: the mechanism is that the follower has not yet repriced proportionally to the leader's information. Half the leader's move is the natural minimal statement of 'has not yet responded proportionally' (a follower that kept up would be at or above 1.0; a follower that has barely moved is far below). 0.5 is a mechanism boundary, not a tuned parameter.
follower_underreaction.strict_and_inclusive_boundaries: BOTH the shock threshold and the underreaction ratio use STRICT inequalities; equality is never a signal
follower_underreaction.zero_btc_return_behavior: cannot occur under BTC_SHOCK (|z| > 3 implies r_btc != 0 when s > 0)
follower_underreaction.zero_follower_return_behavior: r_f(t) == 0.0 => NO_SIGNAL / FOLLOWER_NO_SAME_SIGN_RESPONSE (fail closed; a zero follower return has no sign, so it cannot express same-direction continuation)
follower_underreaction.opposite_sign_follower_behavior: NO_SIGNAL / FOLLOWER_NO_SAME_SIGN_RESPONSE (never a mean-reversion interpretation, never a reversed trade)
follower_underreaction.simultaneous_eth_sol_behavior: ETHUSDT and SOLUSDT are evaluated INDEPENDENTLY on the same leader shock. A shock may produce a signal on ETH only, SOL only, both, or neither; at most ONE concurrent position per follower and at most TWO concurrently overall. There is no cross-follower netting, averaging, ranking or selection: a follower is never chosen because the other one reacted differently.

signal_rules.LONG_RULE: BTC_SHOCK(t) AND r_btc(t) > 0 AND SAME_SIGN(t) AND FOLLOWER_UNDERREACTION(t)  =>  LONG the follower f
signal_rules.SHORT_RULE: BTC_SHOCK(t) AND r_btc(t) < 0 AND SAME_SIGN(t) AND FOLLOWER_UNDERREACTION(t)  =>  SHORT the follower f
signal_rules.NO_SIGNAL_RULE: every decided slot/follower that is not exactly one of the two rules above is NO_SIGNAL; NO_SIGNAL is a first-class outcome, is counted and reported in the decision funnel, and is never re-interpreted as a trade
signal_rules.direction_semantics: CONTINUATION with the leader shock (the follower is expected to finish repricing in the shock direction)
signal_rules.mutual_exclusivity: r_btc(t) > 0 and r_btc(t) < 0 are mutually exclusive, so at most one direction rule can match
signal_rules.reason_code_rule: the FIRST satisfied reason in the frozen order above is recorded for the decision; a signal is emitted only when NO reason applies. Multiple simultaneous failures therefore resolve deterministically.
signal_rules.insufficient_history: fewer than 288 formable trailing leader returns => NO_SIGNAL / LEADER_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE
signal_rules.conflicting_conditions: there are no conflicting conditions by construction; if the frozen precedence finds no reason but no direction rule matches, the decision is NO_SIGNAL (fail closed, never a trade)
signal_rules.stale_data: the rule reads only the aligned slot bars and strictly trailing leader returns; there is no staleness window to violate. A missing bar is handled as missing_data.
signal_rules.missing_data: any required input absent => NO_SIGNAL (fail closed); NO interpolation, NO forward-fill, NO synthetic substitution

entry.anchor: NEXT 5M BAR OPEN OF THE TRADED FOLLOWER
entry.definition: the first follower bar with bar_open_time_ms > decision_time_ms; entry_price = that bar's open; entry_time_ms = that bar's open_time_ms
entry.causality: entry_time_ms > decision_time_ms >= every data_time used; SAME-BAR ENTRY AND SAME-BAR LOOK-AHEAD ARE FORBIDDEN
entry.worked_example: decision at slot t closes at t + 299999. The first follower bar with open_time > decision_time is the bar opening at t + 300000, so entry is at the OPEN of the NEXT 5m bar.
entry.no_decision_on_incomplete_bar: only completed bars inform the decision; the entry bar itself is never read for the decision
entry.fills: single deterministic fill at the bar OPEN price of the entry bar; no intrabar fill model, no slippage model beyond the frozen cost model

exit.definition: exit bar has bar_open_time_ms = entry_bar_open_time_ms + 300000; exit_price = that bar's open; exit_time_ms = that bar's open_time_ms

holding_period.alternate_primary_horizons: NONE (multiple primary horizons are forbidden; alternatives belong to the frozen robustness plan only)
holding_period.selection_basis: the mechanism is a one-step information-transmission lag at the 5m cadence, so the minimal single-bar hold is the discovery mechanic; longer holds would import a trend claim that the mechanism does not make. Chosen from the cadence and the mechanism, NOT from returns.

exit.insufficient_forward_price_data: if the exit bar's open time would exceed end_ms, or the partition has no bar at exactly entry_open_time_ms + 300000, the candidate signal is NOT emitted (NO_SIGNAL / INSUFFICIENT_FORWARD_PRICE_DATA). Positions are never truncated, marked at an ad-hoc price, or dropped ex post.

position_policies.OVERLAP_POLICY: SKIP (a new signal for a follower already holding an open position is DISCARDED, not queued and not pyramided)
position_policies.REENTRY: re-entry is allowed only after the previous position's exit_time_ms has been reached; the earliest possible re-entry is the next signal whose entry_time_ms >= the previous exit_time_ms
position_policies.MULTI_ASSET_CONCURRENCY: the two followers are INDEPENDENT and may hold simultaneous positions; at most ONE concurrent position per follower and at most TWO concurrent positions overall; the leader is never traded; no cross-asset netting, no cross-asset risk overlay at discovery time
position_policies.position_sizing: equal notional per position in return space: each trade is evaluated as a UNIT-notional return (no compounding, no volatility targeting, no leverage overlay); portfolio aggregation is the equal-weighted mean of trade returns

return_definition.funding_cashflow_return: sum over certified funding settlements of the traded follower with entry_time_ms < funding_time_ms <= exit_time_ms of (-direction_sign * funding_rate)
return_definition.cost_return: COST_BPS / 10000 applied once per round trip
return_definition.reporting_requirement: BOTH net_trade_return and net_trade_return_ex_funding must be reported per trade and in aggregate; the two must never be conflated

cost_model.definition: 10 bps is the TOTAL modeled round-trip trading friction (a single canonical number, not decomposed into per-side fees/slippage)
cost_model.sensitivity_role: FROZEN evaluation scenarios / diagnostics, NOT optimization choices; the primary critical gates are evaluated at 10 bps
cost_model.same_trade_set_required: the cost scenarios MUST NOT regenerate signals; all four scenarios are re-priced on the IDENTICAL trade set
cost_model.funding_cashflow_is_not_a_cost: funding cashflow is a separate real flow (see funding_cashflow_accounting) and is never netted into the 10 bps cost number

funding_cashflow_accounting.signal_information_vs_execution_cashflow: SEPARATED BY CONSTRUCTION: ARC-02 never reads a funding rate as a signal
funding_cashflow_accounting.execution_use: funding is used ONLY as CASHFLOW: certified settlements of the traded follower within (entry_time_ms, exit_time_ms]
funding_cashflow_accounting.crosses_settlement: YES - the frozen holding period is 5 minutes and BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT settle every 8h (one settlement per 480 five-minute slots), while SOLUSDT ran a 2h/4h schedule in 2022-11, so a hold can and does contain a settlement. Deterministic accounting is therefore required rather than optional.
funding_cashflow_accounting.cashflow_rule: for each certified settlement in (entry_time_ms, exit_time_ms]: cashflow_return = -direction_sign * funding_rate
funding_cashflow_accounting.settlement_count_is_never_assumed: the accounting iterates the ACTUAL certified settlements in the window and never assumes a fixed count
funding_cashflow_accounting.sign_convention: LONG (direction_sign = +1) PAYS funding when funding_rate > 0 and RECEIVES when funding_rate < 0; SHORT receives/pays the mirror image (Binance USD-M semantics)
funding_cashflow_accounting.boundary_semantics: a settlement exactly at entry_time_ms is NOT charged (already in the entry price); a settlement exactly at exit_time_ms IS charged
funding_cashflow_accounting.notional_basis: constant unit notional fixed at entry (funding applied to the entry notional, no intra-hold notional compounding)
funding_cashflow_accounting.no_synthesis: the cashflow uses the SAME certified funding authority rows as any other consumer, read at their settlement instants; no reconstructed, interpolated or third-party funding series is allowed
funding_cashflow_accounting.ex_funding_gate_independence: G3 is computed from gross_trade_return - cost_return and therefore contains ZERO funding contribution

sample_rules.insufficient_sample_policy: if total eligible trades < 120, or either follower has < 40, the outcome is INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE (terminal FAIL-class; no window extension, no threshold relaxation, no follower reselection to chase N)
sample_rules.no_filtering: no trade may be silently dropped; the decision funnel accounts for every decided slot and follower

controls.control_passes_all_critical_gates_conseq: MECHANISM_NOT_IDENTIFIED => ARC02 = DISCOVERY_FAIL (terminal). No retuning of the primary based on control results is permitted.

orthogonality.aru_kill_rule: net expectancy<=0, PF<=1, or single-asset concentration
structurally_forced_separation: ARC-02 trades WITH the leader's direction and is a CROSS-ASSET continuation claim; H3 is AGAINST a cross-asset spread dislocation and is on 1h bars
ARC-02 reads only open/close of the leader and follower; H5 reads taker-side order-flow fields that the ARC-02 projection physically omits
ARC-02 reads no volume, no open interest and no funding as signal; ARC-03 reads volume and H6 reads open interest
ARC-02's holding period is 1 bar, H3's is 48 bars, ARC-03's is 12 bars, H5's is 1h-bar based
orthogonality.stage_ordering: PRIMARY DISCOVERY FIRST. Orthogonality is a later authorized promotion/robustness stage and is NOT executed at primary discovery. Primary discovery remains performance-blind.
orthogonality.rule: ARC-02 parameters, direction and thresholds MUST NOT be altered in response to an orthogonality or performance result
orthogonality.post_hoc_lead_rule: any sub-population that looks profitable while the primary fails is POST_HOC_LEAD_ONLY: it may never be promoted, and re-testing it requires a NEW_HYPOTHESIS_ID and a NEW_PREREGISTRATION

forbidden_after_failure: second economic attempt under the same hypothesis_id

forbidden_until_discovery_authorized: signal generation on real data for economic purposes
computing returns, PnL, Sharpe, Sortino, profit factor, expectancy or win rate on real data
reading any metric that could influence an economic parameter choice
structural_analysis_allowed: structural signal counts that reveal no future outcome may be computed, but no such count was computed during this builder phase; the PIT battery runs only on synthetic fixtures
experiment_invalidation: spec/manifest hash drift, dataset fingerprint drift, data-authority drift, cadence drift, or ANY economic execution before this prereg commit is independently verified => experiment invalid
limitations: The historical ARC-02 definition was DRAFT_ONLY (never committed), so the frozen thresholds are re-frozen from mechanism and convention rather than preserved from prior authority; the deviations from the draft (minimum observations 144 -> 288, exit anchor close -> open) are recorded explicitly in prior_definition_classification.
The common window starts 2020-09-14 (SOLUSDT admission), so earlier BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT history is deliberately outside the evaluated window.
The first 289 5m slots after the window start produce no decisions (the 288-reference leader history is incomplete, frozen fail-closed).
The last two 5m slots of the common window produce no trades (frozen forward-data guard).
Funding cashflow is charged on the entry notional (frozen O(1e-4) simplification) and is ~1% of trades for BTC/ETH-cadence settlements.
A 5-minute hold produces a very large number of short-lived positions; the primary gates use equal-weighted trade aggregation with no portfolio-level risk overlay at discovery time.
No critical gate covers drawdown; drawdown is a diagnostic output only.
N is a discovery-time unknown; INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE is a possible terminal outcome.

The H3 collision class is MEDIUM in the ARU matrix (a cross-asset claim), so the orthogonality comparator H3 is mandatory at the later authorized stage; it cannot be evaluated at primary discovery without contaminating it.
ARC-02 trades only the two followers; BTC's own behaviour after the shock is never monetised, so the mechanism is tested only through its follower implication.
